rationale: X has a bold dark-teal and orange identity with a specific transect hero (depth gauge, ROV, live readout card) and a large editorial serif, which makes it feel designed rather than assembled. Y is clean and competent but follows a familiar cream, forest-green and rust SaaS pattern, with a simpler hero illustration and a standard card grid. X is the one a design director would ship, and Y is more template-like.
